slides.0.subtitle: Level 1 · Module 2 · Lesson 1
slides.1.title: Five Key Red Varieties
slides.1.points.0: 🍷 Shiraz (Syrah): Australia's flagship grape; 27% of total plantings. Dark fruit, pepper, chocolate
slides.1.points.1: 🌿 Cabernet Sauvignon: 18% plantings; Coonawarra and Margaret River excel. Blackcurrant, cedar, firm tannin
slides.1.points.2: 🎻 Pinot Noir: 6% plantings; Tasmania, Yarra Valley and Mornington lead. Elegant red fruit, silky texture
slides.1.points.3: 🟤 Grenache: SA old vines resurgent; McLaren Vale and Barossa speciality. Red berry, earthy spice
slides.1.points.4: 🍑 Merlot: 9% plantings; blending partner for Cabernet. Plum, chocolate, softer tannin
slides.2.title: Shiraz: Regional Style Differences
slides.2.points.0: 🔴 Barossa Valley: Old Vine Shiraz — ultra-concentrated blackberry, dark chocolate, mocha; 14.5–15.5% abv
slides.2.points.1: 🟠 McLaren Vale: Mediterranean Shiraz — rich and spicy with olive and savoury edge
slides.2.points.2: 🟡 Heathcote: Iron-rich soil gives 'liquid iron' character — dense and earthy
slides.2.points.3: 🟢 Cool-Climate Shiraz (Yarra, Tasmania): lighter body, violet florals, white pepper, 12.5–13.5% abv
slides.2.points.4: 🔵 Grampians: distinctive sparkling Shiraz — a uniquely Australian style
slides.3.question: Which region produces Australia's most iconic old-vine Shiraz, known for ultra-concentrated blackberry and chocolate notes?
slides.3.explanation: Barossa Valley is Australia's most important Shiraz region. Soils free of phylloxera mean many vines are over 100 years old. Old-vine Shiraz produces ultra-concentrated blackberry, dark chocolate and mocha flavours — classic examples are Penfolds Grange and Henschke Hill of Grace.
slides.4.title: Lesson Summary
slides.4.points.0: Australia's five major reds: Shiraz (27%), Cabernet (18%), Merlot (9%), Pinot Noir (6%), Grenache
slides.4.points.1: Shiraz styles vary dramatically by region — from ultra-rich Barossa to delicate cool-climate examples
slides.4.points.2: Grenache is experiencing a major revival in SA old vine regions
